title: CHAPTER 4: SOCIETY REACTS & ESCALATION THE BUNKER TRAP AND SOCIAL BREAKDOWN

segments.line: When the scientist's report leaked online, it sparked wild panic across every major city.
Rich people paid thousands of dollars to lock themselves inside quiet, padded basement rooms. They
believed sitting alone in dark silence would protect them until their timers hit zero safely.
Unfortunately, total isolation backfired fast because human brains get weird when they sit in silence.
Trapped alone with their ticking clocks, terrified bosses accidentally sent their life savings to fake emails.
Supermarkets set up scanners at their front doors, banning anyone with under twenty-four hours left.
Security guards pushed scared shoppers onto the street, causing loud shouting matches in the parking lot.
Pip walked down his quiet apartment hallway, and his frightened neighbors slammed their doors shut.
People peeked through their peepholes, whispering about the dangerous red glow walking past their homes. Pip
sat on his couch and watched his clock drop below forty-five minutes in total silence. His
palms were dripping with cold sweat, and his fingers were shaking like dry leaves.
Every muscle in his body told him to run, but running felt just as dangerous. He was completely
trapped between his own racing thoughts and a timer that never stopped ticking.
Outside his window, sirens wailed through
the night as another neighborhood fell into
